title: Cupel Release
description:
A data release: the strategies, equity curves, rates and self-check cases that the cupel-portfolios app computes books from. Produced by cupel's server and consumed by this app either by API download or from a local folder.

The release lives on disk as a folder: manifest.json at the root, and each part at its 'part' path relative to that root. The SHA-256 of every part is listed in the manifest; the app checks every byte before reading it.

A flat-file release and an API-downloaded release are the same on disk — the app cannot tell the difference.

Manifest.title: manifest.json
Manifest.description: The root file of a release. Lists every part, its size and its SHA-256.

format.description: Format version. This version of the app reads format 1 only.

release_id.description: A positive integer that uniquely identifies this release.

as_of.description: The date through which the data is current (ISO 8601, e.g. 2025-12-31).

rating_method.description: Label describing how runs were rated (e.g. 'in-sample', 'out-of-sample').

runs.description: Count of runs in this release (informational; the real count is rows in runs.parquet).

parts.description: Every file in this release. Required parts: runs.parquet, fx.parquet, margin_rate.parquet, and at least one equity/*.parquet.

part.description: Path of this file relative to the release root (e.g. 'runs.parquet', 'equity/0000101-0000204.parquet').

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the file's bytes. The app checks every part against this before reading it.

RunsParquet.title: runs.parquet
RunsParquet.description:
One row per run (strategy). Required columns are listed below; extra columns are preserved and shown in the catalogue.

File name: runs.parquet

run_id.description: Unique run identifier (int64). Must match the run_id values in the equity files.

name.description: Human-readable run name shown in the catalogue (utf8).

sleeve.description: The currency pool this run belongs to.

cagr.description: Compound annual growth rate over the full equity history (float64, e.g. 0.12 for 12%).

shorts.description: Whether this run may be held short (bool; optional, defaults to false).

evidence_status.description: Evidence status label shown in the catalogue, e.g. 'conclusive', 'inconclusive' (utf8; optional).

EquityParquet.title: equity/<range>.parquet
EquityParquet.description:
Daily equity curves for a contiguous range of runs. Each file name encodes the first and last run_id it contains (zero-padded to 7 digits), e.g. equity/0000101-0000204.parquet.

Rows are sorted by run_id then day. All runs in runs.parquet must appear in exactly one equity file.

run_id.description: Run identifier (int32 or int64). Groups rows for the same run together.

equity.description: Portfolio equity on this day, normalised so the first day equals 1.0 (float64).

margin.description: Gross margin used on this day as a fraction of capital, or 0 if no margin (float64).

FxParquet.title: fx.parquet
FxParquet.description:
Daily CAD/USD exchange rates. Required for Canadian books that hold USD strategies.

File name: fx.parquet

cad_per_usd.description: How many Canadian dollars one US dollar buys on this day (float64).

MarginRateParquet.title: margin_rate.parquet
MarginRateParquet.description:
Monthly margin loan rates by sleeve. Required when any account uses margin.

File name: margin_rate.parquet

month.description: First day of the month this rate applies to (date32 in Parquet).

sleeve.description: Which sleeve's margin loan this rate is for.

rate.description: Annual margin loan rate in percent (float64, e.g. 7.5 for 7.5% per year).

ReferenceJson.title: reference.json
ReferenceJson.description:
Self-check test cases published alongside the data. The app's Data screen can run these to confirm that this machine's calculation matches cupel's.

File name: reference.json (listed as a part in the manifest; optional).

name.description: Human-readable description of this test case.

book.description: The book input (same structure as the app's book JSON).

expect.description: Expected output values. The app checks computed values against these to within floating-point rounding.
